mapper.select: select a.aqi_id as aqiId, a.chinese_explain as chineseExplain, count(s.id) as totalCount from aqi a left join statistics s on a.aqi_id = s.aqi_id group by a.aqi_id, a.chinese_explain order by a.aqi_id
select date_format(confirm_date, '%Y-%m') as statMonth, count(id) as aqiOverCount from statistics where aqi_id >= 3 group by date_format(confirm_date, '%Y-%m') order by statMonth

select p.province_id as provinceId, p.province_abbr as provinceAbbr, p.province_name as provinceName, coalesce(sum(case when s.so2_level >= 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as so2OverCount, coalesce(sum(case when s.co_level >= 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as coOverCount, coalesce(sum(case when s.spm_level >= 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as spmOverCount, coalesce(sum(case when s.aqi_id >= 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as aqiOverCount from grid_province p left join statistics s on p.province_id = s.province_id group by p.province_id, p.province_abbr, p.province_name order by p.province_id
